Brand Introduction:

Monasun is a wellness brand dedicated to creating innovative and effective products that enhance relaxation, comfort, and self-care. Our mission is to help people prioritize their well-being with tools that are easy to use, portable, and designed with their needs in mind.

Product Description:

The 360° Massage Ring is a multifunctional fitness and wellness tool designed to enhance muscle tone, relieve soreness, and improve circulation. With its ergonomic hands-free design, adjustable belt, and compact size, it’s perfect for effortless use during any activity.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

Combining massage, vibration therapy, and body sculpting, the 360° Massage Ring offers 5 vibration levels, 3 massage modes, and versatile functionality for toning and relaxation. Its rechargeable, long-lasting battery ensures consistent performance, making it your ultimate fitness and self-care companion.

Payment Terms:

We offer a 30% commission on every sale referred through your unique affiliate link. Additionally, we can provide a custom 10% discount code for your audience, encouraging more conversions and boosting your earnings. Payments will be made monthly via your preferred method.

Other Information:

  • As part of our ambassador program, you’ll receive free samples of the product to review and use in your content.
  • We’re happy to provide professional product images and additional resources to support your promotion.
  • Our team is always available to assist with any queries or special requests.

We’re excited about the potential of working together and are confident this collaboration will be mutually beneficial! Let us know if you’re interested, and we’ll take the next steps.

Best regards,

Soc Son

Monasun
